title: The 'not SFW' onboarding ineligibility reason is never produced
current: An NSFW or unknown-safety subreddit passes onboarding eligibility; the subreddit_not_sfw reason exists only in types and parsing.
evidence: getAutomaticGoalEligibility checks only that the subreddit is public. isOnboardingIneligibilityReason accepts subreddit_not_sfw, but nothing sets it.
investigate: Ask the maintainer whether onboarding should create goals in NSFW subreddits (#90 restored NSFW goal buttons). Then remove the dead reason or implement it.

criticality.why: Mostly a clarity question unless NSFW onboarding is unwanted.
